basics.description: Deploy a Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro **GeoCatalog** plus optional components: an analytics workstation (VS Code + Python over Azure Bastion), sample-data storage, an Azure OpenAI (Microsoft Foundry) agent, the Microsoft Aurora weather model on a GPU Foundry endpoint, and the official Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro **sample web app** (Azure Static Web App). The GeoCatalog is always deployed; choose the rest. [Learn more](https://github.com/Balunywa/planetary-computer-pro-poc).

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: GeoCatalog is available in these regions during Preview.

basics.name: geoCatalogName
basics.label: GeoCatalog name
basics.toolTip: Lowercase letters and numbers, 3-24 characters. Leave blank to auto-generate a unique name.

options.text: The GeoCatalog is always deployed. Select any additional components below, then configure them on the following tabs.

elements.name: selected
elements.label: Optional components to deploy
elements.toolTip: Select one or more components. Use Select all for the complete environment.

allowedValues.label: Analytics workstation + Azure Bastion
allowedValues.description: Windows VM (VS Code + Python + Git) with private RDP over Azure Bastion; clones the official repo.

allowedValues.label: Sample storage + ingestion identity
allowedValues.description: Storage account and managed identity for the bring-your-own-data ingestion path.

allowedValues.label: Sample web app (Azure Static Web App)
allowedValues.description: The official Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro sample web app (MSAL sign-in + STAC browse + tile map over your GeoCatalog). Provisions a Free-tier Azure Static Web App and, if you supply a GitHub token on the Web app tab, fully auto-wires CI/CD: it sets the deployment-token secret and VITE_* build variables in your repo and triggers the first GitHub Actions build. Configure it on the Web app tab.

allowedValues.label: AI agent (Azure OpenAI / Foundry)
allowedValues.description: Azure OpenAI account + GPT deployment for agentic / reasoning GeoAI scenarios.

allowedValues.label: Aurora weather model (GPU Foundry endpoint)
allowedValues.description: Foundry (Azure ML) workspace + GPU managed-compute endpoint for the Microsoft Aurora model. Requires A100 GPU quota + marketplace terms.

options.text: The workstation is not selected. These settings are ignored.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Administrator username
elements.toolTip: Administrator login for the workstation VM.

toolTip.password: Used for RDP over the Azure Bastion tunnel.

elements.name: seedSampleData
elements.label: Pre-load sample imagery into the GeoCatalog
elements.toolTip: Optional. At deploy time, headlessly create a sample Sentinel-2 collection over the Louisiana Gulf coast (Port Fourchon oil & gas hub) and ingest a few scenes using the workstation identity, so the Explorer already shows imagery on first open. Uncheck for a weather-only demo (the GeoCatalog then starts empty until the storm-impact notebook publishes results).

options.text: The sample web app is not selected. These settings are ignored.

Provide a GitHub personal access token (classic, with 'repo' + 'workflow' scopes) to FULLY auto-wire CI/CD: the deployment sets the Static Web App deployment-token secret in your repo, sets the VITE_* build variables, and triggers the first GitHub Actions build. Your repo must already contain the pcp-web-sample app and the .github/workflows/azure-static-web-apps.yml workflow on the target branch. Leave the token blank to provision an empty Static Web App and wire GitHub manually.

elements.name: githubRepositoryUrl
elements.label: GitHub repository URL
elements.toolTip: HTTPS URL of the GitHub repository that holds the web app and the GitHub Actions workflow.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an HTTPS GitHub repo URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo

elements.name: githubBranch
elements.label: Branch
elements.toolTip: Branch that the GitHub Actions workflow builds and publishes from.

elements.name: githubToken
elements.toolTip: Classic PAT with 'repo' + 'workflow' scopes. Used once during deployment to wire the SWA token secret and build variables, then discarded (not stored on any resource). Leave blank to skip auto-wiring.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid GitHub PAT (starts with ghp_ or github_pat_) or leave blank.

elements.name: entraTenantId
elements.label: Entra tenant ID
elements.toolTip: Directory (tenant) ID of the Entra tenant that owns the SPA app registration and can access the GeoCatalog. Public identifier (not a secret). Required for the web app build to succeed.

elements.name: entraClientId
elements.label: Entra client (application) ID
elements.toolTip: Application (client) ID of the SPA app registration used for MSAL sign-in. Public identifier (not a secret). The app registration must already exist with a SPA redirect URI for the Static Web App URL. Required for the web app build to succeed.

options.text: No AI components are selected. These settings are ignored.

elements.name: openAiDeploymentName
elements.label: Model deployment name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Azure OpenAI model deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 2-64 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.

options.text: Aurora runs on a GPU managed-compute endpoint (Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4). The Foundry workspace + endpoint always deploy; the GPU model only deploys when you supply a model asset ID and have A100 quota + accepted marketplace terms.

elements.name: auroraInstanceType
elements.label: GPU instance type
elements.toolTip: GPU VM size for the Aurora managed-compute deployment. You must have quota for it in the selected region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid VM size, e.g. Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4.

elements.name: auroraModelAssetId
elements.label: Aurora model asset ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Registry model asset. The official storm-impact app uses azureml://registries/azureml/models/Aurora/versions/4. Leave blank to provision the workspace + endpoint only and deploy the model from the portal.
